lines=[];exps=[]
random.seed(1)
for k in range(32):
    p=Rational(random.choice([1,-2,3,5,-7]),random.choice([1,2,3]))
    s=f"({p.p})/({p.q})"
    for _ in range(random.randint(0,4)):
        a,b=random.choice([(1,0),(2,-1),(3,4),(5,2),(1,7),(4,-3),(1,1)])
        e=random.randint(1,2); s+=f"*({a}*x-({b}))**{e}"
    if random.random()<.5: s+="*(x**2+3)"
    lines.append(f"roots({s}, x)  # c")
    P=Poly(eval(s.replace('(','(').replace('/','*Rational(1,1)/'),{'x':x,'Rational':Rational}),x,domain='QQ')
    rr={k:v for k,v in sroots(P).items() if k.is_rational}
    exps.append((P,rr))
open('/work/t3.md','w').write("\n".join(lines))
t=time.time();r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/work/roots.py','/work/t3.md'],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(time.time()-t, r.stderr)
out=json.loads(r.stdout)['cases']; ok=len(out)==32
for c,(P,rr) in zip(out,exps):
    ok&= c['coefficients']==[str(Rational(v)) for v in P.all_coeffs()]
    ok&= {Rational(d['root']):d['multiplicity'] for d in c['rational_roots']}==rr
    res=P
    for k,m in rr.items(): res=res.quo(Poly((x-k)**m,x))
    ok&= c['residual_coefficients']==[str(Rational(v)) for v in res.all_coeffs()]
